Four cycles — Bond 1,466 yr, Hallstatt 2,430 yr, 5×Jose 897 yr, 4×Jose 716 yr — plus the core-mantle resonator episode, fitted JOINTLY (--joint: one design matrix, the USNO/deltaTStart anchors re-optimised with the coefficients, hard closure at J2000, amplitude caps). The legacy single-shot cascade (Bond solo → +Hallstatt → +Jose5 → +Jose4) survives as a stage-wise diagnostic only (fit_metrics). The periods were selected on a retired divisor set (the records are in each cycle's `structural` string and docs/102); the Eddy (999 yr) and Emp862 (862 yr) candidates were tested as 5th/6th flags and rolled back — see the rollback notes in CONFIG.cycles. Narrative: docs/104; the flag audit: docs/105.
